# GroupUi - CSS Framework

This is the repository for the GroupUi CSS framework. The framework is designed to be a lightweight, responsive, and easy-to-use CSS framework for building modern web applications.

## Contributing

We are always happy to see new contributors. Please read our [Contributing Guide](./how-to/CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started.

## Docs

The documentation is available at [https://digitaldesign.volkswagen-group.com](digitaldesign.volkswagen-group.com). Feel free to have a look and reach out if you have further questions.
